IraKur is the pocket reader that you can take everywhere. If you have difficulty reading, in LUP we put artificial intelligence at your service so you can listen to the text of any document in audio, taking only 1 single capture with the camera of your cell phone. To accompany you when studying notes for class, to read the newspaper, the ingredients and prices of products in the supermarket, and much more! If you have dyslexia, low vision, or over the years you find it increasingly difficult to read, in LUP we facilitate reading so you can live your day to day with autonomy.

INCLUDES THE FOLLOWING FEATURES:

- Simple, intuitive design, adapted to your daily life.
-Scan web pages and listen to them with a single click.
-Listen to articles, PDFs, newspapers, magazines, signs, brochures, ingredients ... any digital text or physical text with a single photo.
-Scan, save and listen to pages of physical books with your device's camera.
-Store and share your screenshots in the LUP reading library.
-Apply filters to the screen to help you read and see more clearly. LUP will recommend the filters that best suit you.
-Change your reading speed from 0.5x to 2x, so you won't miss a beat.
-Listen to your readings with HD voices in more than 30 languages. Change the pitch, volume, timbre and genre of the voices.
-Enlarge the text you are interested in with a simple slide, zoom accessible.
-Flashlight at the click of a button, darkness is not a limiting factor for reading.
-Instant translation in all available languages. 

RECOVER YOUR AUTONOMY, LUP APP for the ELDERLY

Letters from the bank, the newspaper, magazines, and any street sign. Stop reading only the headlines. Lup App is the perfect support you need to get you back to reading any document on your own. Take a picture of the document, and listen.

IDEAL FOR STUDENTS

Reading is an everyday tool for those who have to memorize, study for exams and review notes. Thus, we have created LUP App as a tool that facilitates reading, to accompany any student who wants to review and study by listening to their notes. Advance faster and understand better what you read. Specially designed for those students with dyslexia, ADHD, disability, etc.

LISTEN WHILE COMPLETING OTHER TASKS

As someone who listens to a podcast or audiobooks while cleaning the house, walking, or completing other tasks, now with LUP App you can turn any document into an "audiobook". Reading reports, news or official announcements will not prevent you from continuing with your daily tasks.

VISION ACCESSIBILITY

Vision loss is one of the main causes that hinder reading, whether it is due to the passage of time, an accident, or low vision from birth. LUP App focuses on bringing accessibility to any type of everyday document.

LUP, OUR MISSION

We want reading to stop being an obstacle in the daily lives of people, betting on accessibility, inclusion, providing autonomy and avoiding school failure, among others.
In LUP we put technology at the service of people and accessibility, for a more inclusive, equitable and fair world.
